entities.name: María José Sáenz de Buruaga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María José Sáenz de Buruaga Gómez is a Spanish politician from the People’s Party (PP) serving as the President of Cantabria since 2023. President of the party's regional branch since 25 March 2017. She previously served as Vice President of Cantabria and Regional Minister of Health and Social Services from 2011 to 2015.
